mapper.select: SELECT page.id, page.platform_id, page.room_id, page.mapped_status AS status, CASE WHEN page.platform_id = #{miniSource} THEN m.order_no ELSE e.order_no END AS order_no, e.platform_order_no, CASE WHEN page.platform_id = #{miniSource} THEN '小程序' ELSE COALESCE(p.name, '已删除平台') END AS platform_name, e.anchor_id, COALESCE(a.name, '无主播') AS anchor_name, CASE WHEN page.room_id IS NULL THEN '待确认房间' WHEN r.room_number IS NOT NULL THEN r.room_number WHEN page.platform_id = #{miniSource} THEN '已删除房间' ELSE CONCAT('已删除房间（', page.room_id, '）') END AS room_name, CASE WHEN page.platform_id = #{miniSource} THEN m.check_in_date ELSE e.check_in_date END AS check_in_date, CASE WHEN page.platform_id = #{miniSource} THEN m.check_out_date ELSE e.check_out_date END AS check_out_date, CASE WHEN page.platform_id = #{miniSource} THEN m.guest_count ELSE e.guest_count END AS guest_count, CASE WHEN page.platform_id = #{miniSource} THEN COALESCE(m.total_price, 0) ELSE e.total_amount END AS total_amount, CASE WHEN page.platform_id = #{miniSource} THEN 0 ELSE e.platform_fee END AS platform_fee, CASE WHEN page.platform_id = #{miniSource} THEN 0 ELSE e.anchor_fee END AS anchor_fee, e.remark FROM (SELECT * FROM () matches ORDER BY create_time DESC, platform_id ASC, id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}) page LEFT JOIN external_order e ON page.platform_id != #{miniSource} AND e.id=page.id LEFT JOIN booking_order m ON page.platform_id = #{miniSource} AND m.id=page.id LEFT JOIN external_platform p ON p.id=e.platform_id LEFT JOIN external_anchor a ON a.id=e.anchor_id LEFT JOIN room r ON r.id=page.room_id ORDER BY page.create_time DESC, page.platform_id ASC, page.id DESC
